COMMUNITY SERVICE LEARNING — GENERAL ASSESSMENT #17
====

GRADE: Grade 12
SUBJECT: COMMUNITY SERVICE LEARNING
TIME ALLOWED: 45 minutes
TOTAL MARKS: 30
EXAM BODY: KNEC / KCSE pathway

INSTRUCTIONS
----
1. Answer all questions.
2. For calculations, show formula → substitution → steps → final answer with units.
3. For multiple choice, choose the best option.
4. Check your work before submitting.

SECTION A — MULTIPLE CHOICE
----
1. A map key (legend) is used to: (1 mark)
   A. Name the president
   B. Replace the compass rose
   C. Measure rainfall only
   D. Explain symbols used on a map

2. Which statement about Leadership Development 2.0 Life Skills Education 2.1 Building Resilience 2.2 Sup is most accurate for CBC learning? (1 mark)
   A. Treat Leadership Development 2.0 Life Skills Education 2.1 Building Resilience 2.2 Sup as rumours only.
   B. Explain Leadership Development 2.0 Life Skills Education 2.1 Building Resilience 2.2 Sup with correct facts and a clear Kenyan example.
   C. Skip evidence when discussing Leadership Development 2.0 Life Skills Education 2.1 Building Resilience 2.2 Sup.
   D. Say Leadership Development 2.0 Life Skills Education 2.1 Building Resilience 2.2 Sup never happens in Kenya.

3. Which statement about Problem Validation is most accurate for CBC learning? (1 mark)
   A. Treat Problem Validation as rumours only.
   B. Explain Problem Validation with correct facts and a clear Kenyan example.
   C. Skip evidence when discussing Problem Validation.
   D. Say Problem Validation never happens in Kenya.

4. Which statement about Building Resilience 2.2 Support Systems 2.3 Making Important Choices 3.0 Action  is most accurate for CBC learning? (1 mark)
   A. Treat Building Resilience 2.2 Support Systems 2.3 Making Important Choices 3.0 Action  as rumours only.
   B. Skip evidence when discussing Building Resilience 2.2 Support Systems 2.3 Making Important Choices 3.0 Action .
   C. Explain Building Resilience 2.2 Support Systems 2.3 Making Important Choices 3.0 Action  with correct facts and a clear Kenyan example.
   D. Say Building Resilience 2.2 Support Systems 2.3 Making Important Choices 3.0 Action  never happens in Kenya.

5. Which statement about Support Systems is most accurate for CBC learning? (1 mark)
   A. Say Support Systems never happens in Kenya.
   B. Explain Support Systems with correct facts and a clear Kenyan example.
   C. Skip evidence when discussing Support Systems.
   D. Treat Support Systems as rumours only.

6. Kenya’s capital city is: (1 mark)
   A. Nakuru
   B. Nairobi
   C. Mombasa
   D. Kisumu

7. Citizenship responsibility includes: (1 mark)
   A. Littering in markets
   B. Destroying road signs
   C. Obeying laws and caring for public property
   D. Avoiding all community work

8. Which statement about Making Important Choices is most accurate for CBC learning? (1 mark)
   A. Say Making Important Choices never happens in Kenya.
   B. Explain Making Important Choices with correct facts and a clear Kenyan example.
   C. Treat Making Important Choices as rumours only.
   D. Skip evidence when discussing Making Important Choices.

9. A budget helps a family to: (1 mark)
   A. Avoid saving forever
   B. Ignore prices in shops
   C. Plan income and spending wisely
   D. Hide all money underground

10. Which statement about Leadership Development is most accurate for CBC learning? (1 mark)
   A. Say Leadership Development never happens in Kenya.
   B. Skip evidence when discussing Leadership Development.
   C. Treat Leadership Development as rumours only.
   D. Explain Leadership Development with correct facts and a clear Kenyan example.

11. Which statement about Implementation and Reflection is most accurate for CBC learning? (1 mark)
   A. Treat Implementation and Reflection as rumours only.
   B. Say Implementation and Reflection never happens in Kenya.
   C. Explain Implementation and Reflection with correct facts and a clear Kenyan example.
   D. Skip evidence when discussing Implementation and Reflection.

12. Which statement about Advocacy in the Community 1.2 Leadership Development 2.0 Life Skills Education 2 is most accurate for CBC learning? (1 mark)
   A. Explain Advocacy in the Community 1.2 Leadership Development 2.0 Life Skills Education 2 with correct facts and a clear Kenyan example.
   B. Say Advocacy in the Community 1.2 Leadership Development 2.0 Life Skills Education 2 never happens in Kenya.
   C. Skip evidence when discussing Advocacy in the Community 1.2 Leadership Development 2.0 Life Skills Education 2.
   D. Treat Advocacy in the Community 1.2 Leadership Development 2.0 Life Skills Education 2 as rumours only.

SECTION B — STRUCTURED / SHORT ANSWERS
----
13. In three clear sentences, explain Social Enterprise Exhibition and give one Kenyan example. (4 marks)

14. In three clear sentences, explain Advocacy in the Community 1.2 Leadership Development 2.0 Life Skills Education 2 and give one Kenyan example. (4 marks)

15. In three clear sentences, explain Advocacy in the Community and give one Kenyan example. (4 marks)

16. In three clear sentences, explain Leadership Development 2.0 Life Skills Education 2.1 Building Resilience 2.2 Sup and give one Kenyan example. (4 marks)

====

1. D — Explain symbols used on a map

2. B — Explain Leadership Development 2.0 Life Skills Education 2.1 Building Resilience 2.2 Sup with correct facts and a clear Kenyan example.

3. B — Explain Problem Validation with correct facts and a clear Kenyan example.

4. C — Explain Building Resilience 2.2 Support Systems 2.3 Making Important Choices 3.0 Action  with correct facts and a clear Kenyan example.

5. B — Explain Support Systems with correct facts and a clear Kenyan example.

6. B — Nairobi

7. C — Obeying laws and caring for public property

8. B — Explain Making Important Choices with correct facts and a clear Kenyan example.

9. C — Plan income and spending wisely

10. D — Explain Leadership Development with correct facts and a clear Kenyan example.

11. C — Explain Implementation and Reflection with correct facts and a clear Kenyan example.

12. A — Explain Advocacy in the Community 1.2 Leadership Development 2.0 Life Skills Education 2 with correct facts and a clear Kenyan example.

15. (4 marks)
Award marks for: (1) accurate definition/idea of Advocacy in the Community; (2) correct use of subject terms; (3) a relevant local example (home, school, market, farm, or community). Do not award for slogans with no content.

16. (4 marks)
Award marks for: (1) accurate definition/idea of Leadership Development 2.0 Life Skills Education 2.1 Building Resilience 2.2 Sup; (2) correct use of subject terms; (3) a relevant local example (home, school, market, farm, or community). Do not award for slogans with no content.
